{
  "decision": "CREATE",
  "type": "exploratory",
  "scope": "ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is hidden in a receptacle and the destination is also a receptacle type present in the room.",
  "hypothesis": "Prioritizing search of receptacles that match the destination type (e.g., drawers if placing on a drawer) reduces total steps compared to scanning all visible receptacles in arbitrary or listed order.",
  "guidance": "Identify the destination receptacle type from the task instruction. Navigate to and inspect only those receptacles matching that type first. If the target is not found after exhausting same-type candidates, resume standard full-room search.",
  "probe_spec": {
    "local_function": "Select next candidate receptacle for inspection during search phase.",
    "realization_pattern": "Filter visible receptacles by type matching the destination; iterate through filtered subset before unfiltered remainder.",
    "capability_requirements": [
      "go to",
      "open",
      "take"
    ],
    "adaptive_policy": "At each step, check current location's contents. If target found, take it. If not, move to next same-type receptacle. If no same-type receptacles remain unchecked, move to any unchecked receptacle of other types.",
    "evidence_goal": "Compare number of 'go to' actions required to find the target against baseline established-search-listed-order-general.",
    "stop_conditions": [
      "Target object acquired.",
      "All same-type receptacles inspected without finding target (fallback triggered).",
      "Maximum search iterations reached."
    ],
    "required_downstream_state": "Agent holding the target object."
  },
  "source_grounding": {
    "entry_action": "go to drawer_1",
    "why_grounded": "The entry observation lists drawer_1 as a visible entity, and 'go to drawer_1' is an admissible action at the start state.",
    "public_capability_evidence": [
      "The public entry observation exposes these candidate receptacles through exact admissible go-to actions: cabinet_1, cabinet_2, cabinet_3, cabinet_4, cabinet_5, cabinet_6, coffeemachine_1, countertop_1, countertop_2, countertop_3, drawer_1, drawer_2, drawer_3, fridge_1, garbagecan_1, microwave_1, shelf_1, shelf_2, shelf_3, sinkbasin_1, stoveburner_1, stoveburner_2, stoveburner_3, stoveburner_4, toaster_1",
      "The requested object is not exposed by an exact public take action at entry."
    ]
  },
  "provenance": [
    "b_handoff.functional_contract",
    "current_task.instruction",
    "pre_update_established_memories[0]"
  ],
  "reason": "The incumbent memory uses a generic listed-order search. Since the destination is a drawer, testing whether searching drawers first yields faster acquisition is a credible local optimization grounded in the specific task structure."
}
